content.short: Reown is the leading Web3 infrastructure provider behind WalletConnect, offering SDKs for seamless UX.
content.description:
Reown is the definitive Web3 infrastructure provider, formerly known as WalletConnect, dedicated to providing the essential tools needed for seamless and secure on-chain user experiences. The platform offers a comprehensive suite of SDKs, including AppKit and WalletKit, which allow developers to integrate intuitive wallet connections, social logins, and cross-chain functionality into their applications with ease. Reown acts as the foundational communication layer for the decentralized web, powering thousands of dApps and millions of user sessions daily.

By simplifying the complexities of blockchain interaction, Reown enables builders to focus on core functionality while ensuring that users have a Frictionless path to exploring the decentralized economy. The protocol supports a wide range of networks and is designed for maximum interoperability and security. Through its commitment to user-centric design and open-source development, Reown is building the essential framework for mass adoption, where decentralized technology is as accessible and intuitive as the traditional web.
content.meta: Reown provides essential SDKs and infrastructure for seamless wallet connectivity and Web3 user experiences.
